_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to _local/strategy.json (gitignored) and replace every <placeholder>, then seed it into profile_strategy with the operator-run seeder. This document is doctrine: it is per-tenant database data, and no filled-in copy may ever be committed. The shape is validated by TenantStrategy in packages/shared. Deliberately contains NO numbers.
refreshed_at: <YYYY-MM-DD when these values were last checked against the strategy source>

pacing._comment: Run-rate governor. The cut order is fixed method, not a threshold. Pacing is a three-band decision: warn_above reports, act_above triggers the cut order, underpace_below flags budget left on the table. run_rate_tolerance is the older single-tolerance form, kept optional for back-compat.
pacing.run_rate_tolerance: <DEPRECATED fraction, e.g. how far off pace before acting>
pacing.act_above: <fraction of pace: run the cut order>

opt_groups._comment: One entry per optimization group. Group names are yours; these keys are the contract. bid_floor/bid_ceiling are the manual bounds the bidding engine clamps to before caps; the *_unit key says how to read the *_value.

<your-group-name>.max_increase_steady: <fraction: the CEILING once the group is in steady state>
<your-group-name>.spend_share_max: <fraction of profile spend this group may take>
<your-group-name>.tacos_x_breakeven_min: <multiple of breakeven TACOS, low end of the band>
<your-group-name>.tacos_x_breakeven_max: <multiple of breakeven TACOS, high end of the band>

rank_lifecycle._comment: Durations state their unit in the key: dwell_days is DAYS, graduate_weeks_stable is WEEKS.
rank_lifecycle.dwell_days: <int DAYS held before the lifecycle moves a keyword>
rank_lifecycle.graduate_weeks_stable: <int WEEKS of stable rank required to graduate>
rank_lifecycle.regression_reescalate: <what a regressed keyword returns to, e.g. a stage name>

cooldown_bypasses: <lever name from levers that may ignore the cooldown>
staged_apply.tag_format: <template for the tag written onto a changed entity, e.g. with a {run} placeholder>
staged_apply.push_rank_min_days: <int DAYS between two pushes on the same rank target>
priority_order: <lever name from levers, highest priority first>

group_cadence.<your-group-name>: <how often this group is touched, e.g. a cadence name>

bids.start_bid_pct_of_recommended: <signed int, e.g. start N% below the suggested bid>
bids.mechanical_bid_step: <currency interval whose multiples should be moved by one legal cent>
bids.mechanical_placement_step: <integer placement interval whose multiples should move by one legal point>

sv_bands._comment: Search-volume bands. severity 'warn' reports and allows; 'fail' blocks.

caps._comment: Caps are ceilings. The optimizer clamps to them and never aims at them.

discovery.min_root_words: <int words a root must have to count as a discovery root>

expanded_candidate_filter._comment: Gate an expanded (tool- or agent-suggested) candidate must clear before it is considered.

dayparting._comment: Marketing Stream evidence policy. Both values are tenant-owned and the worker refuses to acknowledge deliveries until they are filled and seeded.
dayparting.settling_window_hours: <non-negative number of hours before evidence is settled>
dayparting.budget_capped_at_percent: <non-negative budget-usage percentage that marks a capped hour>

recommendation_evidence._comment: Tenant-owned gates for synchronized matched pre/post recommendation evidence. No defaults exist in application source.
recommendation_evidence.synchronizationTolerance: <non-negative numeric tolerance for the synchronized exported value>

naming._comment: Campaign naming. Mirrors the bulk-creator naming settings so proposed names match what gets created. goal: Discovery|Rank|Profit; match_type: EXACT|BROAD|PHRASE|ASIN_EXACT; campaign_type: SKW|Halo|BMM|Phrase|PAT. descriptor placeholders: {keyword} {root} {counter}.
